# Intpot

> Intpot is an open-source typed Python interface framework. Define a tool once, then serve or convert it across CLI, FastAPI, and MCP interfaces.

## Install

Requires Python 3.11 or later.

```sh
pip install intpot
```

## Quick start

```python
from intpot import App

app = App("my-app")

@app.tool()
def add(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    """Add two numbers."""
    return a + b
```

Serve the same declaration with `intpot serve app.py --cli`, `--api`, or `--mcp`.

## Primary resources

- [Documentation](https://intpot.modepot.io/): project overview and product position.
- [Quick start](https://intpot.modepot.io/quickstart/): install Intpot and serve one declaration in three ways.
- [Capabilities and boundaries](https://intpot.modepot.io/capabilities/): supported conversions, runtime behavior, and current limitations.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/tugrulguner/intpot): code, tests, examples, releases, and contribution guidance.
- [PyPI package](https://pypi.org/project/intpot/): published Python distributions and release metadata.
- [ModePot](https://modepot.io/): return to the open-source project family.

## Boundaries and license

- Intpot is alpha software.
- Unsupported framework features are reported explicitly rather than translated silently.
- License: MIT.
